title: Gemini Function-Calling Surface — V3
description: Exhaustive enumeration of tools Gemini may invoke. The Cloud Run server validates every tool call before execution. No free SQL, no price mutation, no order changes, no model-invented URLs.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the product catalog by keywords and structured filters. Returns raw product records for ranking. Never invent product IDs — only use IDs returned by this tool.

category_ids.description: Only use category_ids returned by list_categories — never invent.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Server caps at 48 regardless.

server_validation: category_ids verified against tenant taxonomy — unknown IDs return empty set, not error
unknown filter keys stripped before execution
empty keywords array returns top-selling products (not an error)

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get full structured details of a specific product. Only use product IDs previously returned by search_catalog — never invent IDs.

product_id.description: WooCommerce product ID. Must have been returned by search_catalog in this session.

server_validation: product_id must exist in tenant's catalog
invisible/draft/deleted products return 404 — model must handle gracefully
model may not call get_product on IDs it invented

tools.name: decompose_recipe
tools.description: Decompose a dish or meal name into ingredient search keywords. Returns keyword strings only — not prices, stock, or availability. Never assert allergen or origin status in this response.

dish_name.description: Name of the dish or meal to decompose, in any supported language.

servings.description: Number of servings — used to suggest quantities, not to change which ingredients are returned.

server_validation: result feeds into search_catalog keywords — it is a string array, not a product list
allergen and origin must NOT be asserted in this response
result is cached by dish_name + locale for 24h

tools.name: extract_filters
tools.description: Parse natural-language constraints into structured search filters (price range, occasion, dietary requirements, etc.).

text.description: The natural-language constraint text to parse.

server_validation: returns a partial filters object; unknown keys stripped
locale must be in allowed list — others default to he-IL
price values are advisory and must be validated against actual WC price range

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Return the tenant's available product categories. Use this to discover valid category_ids before calling search_catalog with category filters. Never invent category IDs.

parent_id.description: If provided, return only categories under this parent. null returns top-level categories.

server_validation: result is scoped to tenant_id — no cross-tenant data
returns id, name, slug, count — no pricing or inventory
result is cached per tenant for 10 min

prohibited_tools.description: The following must NEVER appear in the function-calling surface. Any code review finding one of these in Gemini's available tools must be treated as a critical security defect.

entries.name: add_to_cart
entries.reason: Commerce is WC Store API domain — model must not trigger cart changes

entries.name: update_price
entries.reason: Price is set by WooCommerce; AI has no write access

entries.name: get_user_data
entries.reason: PII; model has no user identity context
